caption: Tokens become vectors, a width-2 filter slides over neighbouring pairs, ReLU keeps the positive scores, max-pooling keeps the strongest one, and a dense layer with softmax gives the sentiment. The pooled output has one number per filter, not one per token.

spec.title: 1D CNN for sentiment
spec.aria: Pipeline from tokens through word embeddings, a width-2 one-dimensional convolution, max-pooling over positions, to a softmax over sentiment classes.
